summary: Batch program that sequentially reads the card-to-account cross-reference file (XREFFILE) and displays every cross-reference record. A simple browse utility linking card numbers to account ids; open, loop read-and-display until end-of-file, close. Any I/O error prints the status and abends.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Announce start. Open the cross-reference file. Loop until end-of-file: read the next XREF record and, while not at end-of-file, display it. Close the file, announce end, and return.
paragraphs.notes: Driver; sequential read-and-display loop over the card/account cross-reference.

paragraphs.name: 1000-XREFFILE-GET-NEXT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the next cross-reference record. On success ('00') display it; status '10' means end-of-file (16); any other status is an error (12). If OK continue; if end-of-file set END-OF-FILE='Y'; otherwise report the error and abend.
branches: IF APPL-AOK ... ELSE IF APPL-EOF ... ELSE (abend)
paragraphs.notes: Same status-flag pattern as the other CBACT browse programs.

paragraphs.name: 0000-XREFFILE-OPEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Open the cross-reference file for input; on non-'00' status print an open error and abend.

paragraphs.name: 9000-XREFFILE-CLOSE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Close the cross-reference file; on non-'00' status print a close error and abend.

paragraphs.name: 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
paragraphs.pseudocode: Set abend code 999 and call CEE3ABD to force an abnormal end.

paragraphs.name: 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Format and display the file status code, handling VSAM extended (9nn) codes.
branches: IF IO-STATUS NOT NUMERIC OR IO-STAT1 = '9' ... ELSE
